primary_estimate_meaning: SIGNED TEST ONLY of whether the debiased squared age effect varies with local_snp_contribution_score_z; the magnitude is NOT reportable as a proportional change because the family mean is not separated from zero at alpha (family_mean_not_separated_from_zero_at_this_level, den_z 1.11)
wording: Cross-sectional postmortem data: write "age-associated methylation differences", never "methylation change with age". Donor age is confounded with birth cohort and survival.
catalog_scope_note: VMRs were selected on residual SD after regressing methylation PCs 1-5 computed WITHOUT age adjustment (01_vmr_catalog/_h/01_analyze.R). If a methylation PC tracks age, the catalog under-samples regions whose variability is mostly age-driven. Stage 00 measures the methPC-age correlation; results describe age effects within this catalog.
null_result_meaning: A null axis result means age-effect magnitude does not track local genetic control within this catalog. It is not evidence that low-control VMRs are environmentally determined (AGENTS.md 2.3), nor the reverse.
